## Summary

| Protein | Gene | UniProt | Length | Mass |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Recoverin | **RCVRN** | P35243 | 200 aa | **23.13 kDa** |
| Guided entry of tail-anchored proteins factor 1 (WRB) | GET1 | O00258 | 174 aa | 19.78 kDa |

**RCVRN is heavier** by ~3.35 kDa (26 residues). Masses were computed from the actual UniProt sequences with Biopython and match the UniProt flat-file MW values (23,130 Da and 19,780 Da) exactly.

One data caveat: UniProt's JSON API summary fields for GET1 reported 218 aa / 24,725 Da, which contradicts the record's own sequence string, its FASTA, and its flat-file header (174 AA; 19,780 MW). I treated the sequence-derived value as authoritative.
